title: Sage's released policy against the split on net1 v4: test links, once
description: The single test of the comparison with Sage, the one row of expliCCit's results not yet run here (expliCCit reports that its split costs about 5% utilization and 9% queueing delay against Sage). Sage's released policy (release exp-sage-model-24; MIT-licensed) runs as a hold agent next to the fixed rule (u = 0.125) and the share rule (k = 1) on net1 v4, both fixed before this run, and all 17 kernel controllers, on the 27 test links: the five families (seeds 13 and 31), BBRv3 or Westwood from 0 s, and 2 and 4 copies of Sage, the two rules, BBRv3, Cubic and BBRv1 for 30 s (experiments/copies.py, seed 31). Reported: log utility against BBRv3, the copies' fairness and queueing delay, and utilization and queueing delay against Sage where the flow is alone (experiments/sage_report.py).
prepare: G="$IN/grid/$(cat "$IN/grid/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; SAGE="$IN/sage/sage/sage.onnx"; echo "fc0d6f1da45e4948ee3d96784642793954ed5e52adc1eddd0c9883d5d8fe2f9e  $SAGE" | sha256sum -c; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v4" "$G" --u 0.125; uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/share" "$G" --u0 0.125 --k 1; P=(--policy "sage=$SAGE" --policy "rule-v4=$OUT/v4/rule-u0.125.onnx" --policy "share-k1=$OUT/share/share-u0.125-k1.onnx"); experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" test 13 31 all "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60" --split test --family held-competitors --duration-ms 60000 --seed 31 --stock all "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-held-competitors-60"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split test --duration-ms 30000 --seed 31 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3,cubic,bbr "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart held-competitors-60 copies-30s && uv run python experiments/copies_report.py "$OUT" && uv run python experiments/sage_report.py "$OUT"
